reviews.positive: Location
reviews.negative:
This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result.

The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers.

The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation.

To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises.

I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway.

Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem.

Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment.

It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.
reviews.partner_reply: Thank you for sharing such detailed feedback. We're very sorry to hear that your experience fell so far below the standard you remember from previous stays. The issues you describe, including cleanliness in shared areas, the behaviour of some long-term residents and the quality of our meals, do not reflect the environment we want for our guests. We also regret that your interactions with our customer service team felt more focused on process than on resolving your concerns. We sincerely apologize for this. Your comments have been shared with our management, housekeeping and front office teams so the concerns you raised can be reviewed. We appreciate the efforts of our Sydney team. We are sorry that your stay did not reflect the welcoming and well-run property we aim to provide. Thank you again for bringing these matters to our attention. We wish you all the best in your future travels.

1) Service 2) Location

reviews.negative:
The toilets- 1) Very limited 2) Very dirty. 
There were 4 shower rooms, one malfunctioning. And there were >10 dorm rooms in a level. Assuming each room has 4 beds, so there were about 40 people in a level. 
1) 40 people sharing 4 shower rooms... I had a difficult time searching for an empty one every time.
2) Some toilets were clogged, some were not flushed, some bins were overflowed with toilet paper. 
The ratio of user:toilet/shower is too high! 10 people sharing 1 shower room, and that is only based on a conservative assumption of the number of pax per level. Of course it would be soooo dirty!
I've stayed in a few youth hostels before and this is the worst experience I've ever had.

Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia.

I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code.

I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm.

When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed.

I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm.

I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told.

I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor.

By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service.

My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address.

This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.

analysis.positive_en: The free dinner, the beds, and the rooms with a blackout curtain. Spacious rooms.
analysis.negative_en: The reception was online-only and impersonal; staff seem to manage multiple properties and conversations with others were shared. reviews.title: Que sea barato no implica que su mantenimiento sea deficiente.
reviews.positive:
Si estás valorando este hostel en tu estancia en Sydney posiblemente será por su ubicación y porque es de los que incluye desayuno y cena en el precio.

Posiblemente ambos puntos son sus claras ventajas para decidirse frente a otros, aunque con matices.

Respecto a la ubicación, personalmente creo que es su punto fuerte. Bien conectado a la estación central de tren, está en un punto que andando puedes llegar a Circular Quay en apenas 30-40 minutos andando a un ritmo normal. Estás en un punto que si te decides por ir a The Rocks, o a la zona de Chinatown, también está a menos de 30 minutos andando, por lo que estás prácticamente en el centro de todo.
Si además planeas acercarte a Bondi Beach desde aquí, hay línea de autobús y en menos de 1h de trayecto estás allí con un solo transbordo.

Otro de sus puntos positivos, en mi caso debo destacar las habitaciones. Literas rígidas y cómodas que no se mueven en absoluto (si has ido a otros hostel sabes de lo que hablo). Colchones decentes por el precio a pagar y habitación relativamente correcta en cuanto a espacio (al menos en las habitaciones de 6 personas).

Por último, la parte del desayuno y cena que incluyen en el precio. Desde luego que es una ventaja frente a otras opciones de hostel que no incluyen nada. Desayuno básico que se sirve de 7:30am a 9am, incluye zumo, leche, té/café, cereales y pan de molde con diferentes mermeladas, mantequilla y crema de cacahuete. Eso es todo. Simple y básico. Y lo mismo ocurre en la cena. Horario de 18:30pm a 19:45pm, suelen ser platos básicos donde no podemos destacar que sean las mejores opciones nutritivamente hablando. Pasta algunos días, pollo con puré de patata otros, o arroz con carne picada. No esperes la mejor cena posible, de hecho da más sensación de comedor social que de hostel.
reviews.negative:
Soy crítico porque en mis últimos 5 meses viajando he estado en muchos hostel y entiendo que si busco las opciones más económicas, renuncio a ciertas comodidades que otros más caros si me ofrecen (como más cantidad de baños, cocinas más grandes y más equipadas, zonas comunes de mejor calidad y más amplias, etc).

Lo que no está bien es la falta de mantenimiento general del lugar. Es un hostel viejo si nos centramos en sus comodidades, y salvo las habitaciones que a mi parecer estaban en buen estado general, el resto fue bastante decepcionante.

La mayoría de baños estaban viejos y no funcionaban como deberían. Ya sea un grifo roto, una ducha sin mucha presión de agua u otro con el suelo siempre con agua. Se notaba una falta de mantenimiento del lugar. Por no decir que en general estaban sucios. Paredes de las duchas por ejemplo que dudo se hayan limpiado en los últimos meses, papeleras llenas muchas ocasiones, y en definitiva, sensación de abandono.

Por supuesto, entiendo que pagar un precio reducido por una noche en Sydney con desayuno y cena incluido, tienes que renunciar a cierto confort en tu estancia. Pero eso no implica llegar a un lugar con poco mantenimiento y con zonas sucias en general.

analysis.title_en: Being cheap doesn't imply that its maintenance is deficient.
analysis.positive_en: If you're evaluating this hostel for your stay in Sydney, its location is probably its clear advantage, and it includes breakfast and dinner in the price. The location is strong, well connected to Central Station, and within walking distance to The Rocks, Chinatown, Circular Quay, and Bondi Beach with a single transfer. The rooms have rigid, comfortable bunks that don’t move, decent mattresses for the price, and the six-person rooms feel reasonably spacious. The included breakfast and dinner are a real perk compared with other hostels that offer nothing.
analysis.negative_en: The maintenance of the place is lacking. It's an old hostel, and apart from the rooms, the rest is quite disappointing. Most bathrooms are old and don't work as they should, with issues like broken taps, low water pressure in showers, and floors that stay wet. They also seem dirty overall, with unclean shower walls and garbage bins frequently full, giving a sense of neglect. Paying a reduced price with meals included means you have to compromise on comfort, but this doesn't оправimate arriving at a place with poor upkeep and dirty areas.

reviews.positive:
The breakfast looked reasonable.
The staff DID resolve the booking in issues, but it took way to long to solve
reviews.negative:
My booking was not processed by the time I arrived, this was resolved fairly quickly
The bed I was allocated was already taken. It took over an hour to get allocated a new bed, after driving for 7.5 hours to get there, this was not a good start
The dinner was a simple bowl of thin soup. I realise this is budget accommodation, but really I was expecting slightly better
The bathrooms and toilets were in a terrible state. Renovated with what every could be found it seemed. Water all over the floor.
I took a picture of one toilet which I have attached
The property charges for locks for the lockers. You would think they the supplied lockers would have combinations or electronic locks since the check in is all electronic
In the property pictures they show a neat bed with towels and soap on them. Reality is you have to BUY a towel and no soap was provided
In short, if you stay here bring you own towel, soap and lock and the pictures in the property profile are taken at some other place NOT at this location

Regarding the bathrooms, we maintain scheduled cleaning throughout the day; however, shared facilities can occasionally become untidy between cleaning rounds.

We appreciate your comments and wish you all the best in your future travels.

Kind regards,
Azzurro Management

analysis.title_en: I would not recommend it at all.
analysis.positive_en: A few steps from Pyrmont Bridge and King Street Wharf.
analysis.negative_en: No staff at the reception, the check-in is online. And when there is a problem you have to speak to a screen… Rooms are not cleaned (trash under the bed on arrival, which were still there at departure, almost a week later!). Almost all sinks are blocked, so dirty water stagnates. There is no ventilation in the showers, so besides the suffocating heat, condensation water runs down the walls and drips from the ceiling. The kitchen, which is not really a kitchen, leaves a lot to be desired! Not enough space in the fridges and cupboards, moldy food, two portable cooking plates (a plate with only one burner) for the whole hostel!! No elevator, so if you are on the first or second floor, good luck carrying your luggage and going up stairs several times a day!

Sehr enttäuschender Aufenthalt

Unser Aufenthalt in diesem Hostel war leider sehr enttäuschend. Auf den Bildern wirkte alles sehr gepflegt, relativ neu und durch die angeblichen 4 Sterne auch durchaus ansprechend. Vor Ort bot sich jedoch ein komplett anderes Bild.

Bereits beim Betreten des Eingangs fiel ein sehr unangenehmer Geruch auf, der stark an einen nassen Hund erinnerte. Das gesamte Gebäude sowie die Zimmer machten einen stark heruntergekommenen Eindruck. Der Aufenthalts- bzw. Speiseraum war ungepflegt und überhaupt nicht einladend, um dort seine Mahlzeiten einzunehmen. Tische und Wände waren sichtbar dreckig.

Die Toiletten erinnerten eher an öffentliche WCs am Hauptbahnhof – so unappetitlich, dass man sich regelrecht davor ekelte, dort zu duschen. Auch die Vorhänge und Betten waren befleckt und schmutzig.

Nach Rücksprache mit dem Hostelpersonal wurde uns mitgeteilt, dass Reinigungsmittel zur Verfügung stehen. Ganz ehrlich: Es ist zwar ein Hostel und man erwartet keinen Luxus, aber zu verlangen, dass Gäste selbst den Dreck anderer beseitigen, weil das Housekeeping nicht hinterherkommt, ist schlichtweg frech.

Alles in allem kann ich nur sagen: Verlasst euch nicht auf die positiven Bewertungen dieses Hostels – sie spiegeln die Realität absolut nicht wider.
reviews.partner_reply:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that our hostel operates as a budget, shared accommodation, and the facilities, furnishings, and common areas are accurately represented in our listing photos and descriptions. While we do not offer hotel-level luxury, we maintain daily cleaning schedules for all shared spaces and bedrooms, and our housekeeping team follows strict hygiene and inspection procedures.

Regarding cleaning supplies, these are made available as an optional convenience for guests who wish to tidy personal or shared spaces during peak periods, which is common practice in many hostels. This does not replace our housekeeping service.

We also note that our accommodation continues to receive consistent positive feedback from a large number of guests who value the location, affordability, and social atmosphere we provide. That said, we understand that hostel-style accommodation may not be suitable for everyone, particularly those expecting private-hotel standards.

We appreciate all feedback and will continue monitoring our facilities closely to ensure standards are maintained. We wish you all the best in your future travels.

analysis.negative_en:
Very disappointing stay
Our stay at this hostel was unfortunately very disappointing. In the pictures everything looked well maintained, relatively new, and, due to the supposed 4 stars, quite appealing. On site, however, a completely different picture presented itself.

As soon as you enter the entrance, a very unpleasant smell struck, strongly reminiscent of a wet dog. The entire building and the rooms gave a heavily dilapidated impression. The lounge/ dining area was unkempt and not inviting at all for having meals there. Tables and walls were visibly dirty.

The toilets reminded more of public toilets at a main train station – so unappetizing that one almost recoiled from showering there. Curtains and beds were also stained and dirty.

After consulting hostel staff, we were told that cleaning agents were available. Honestly: it’s a hostel and you don’t expect luxury, but to demand that guests themselves remove the dirt of others because housekeeping isn’t keeping up is simply rude.

All in all I can only say: don’t rely on the positive reviews of this hostel – they absolutely do not reflect reality.

reviews.title: HORRÍVEL
reviews.positive: Não gostei de absolutamente nada.
reviews.negative:
O hostel é IMUNDO, bagunçado e feio. Quando você entra no hostel tem um corredorzinho apertado e lotado de malas e não existe ninguem para te recepcionar. A "recepcionista" é uma mini televisão onde fica uma atendente remota, das Filipinas, para fazer seu check in. Não tem ninguem na gerência do hostel para te atender. Entrando para a cozinha e área comum, a coisa piora MUITO. Tudo muito, muito sujo e bagunçado, A cozinha um caos e as geladeiras tão lotadas que era impossível sequer guardar uma água lá dentro.
Fiquei em dois quartos pois a primeira noite dividi com amigos. O primeiro quarto estava congelando e não tinha como aumentar o ar, muito menos reclamar com alguém do hostel fantasma. O banheiro era externo, dividido com todo o andar e estava um completo NOJO. IMUNDO, não tenho nem palavras para descrever aquele chiqueiro.
O segundo quarto era apenas feminino, ficava no que parecia um anexo ao predio principal e sempre que alguem andava pelo quarto, minha cama tremia pois o chao não tem boa sustentação. O banheiro estava sujo também, mas um pouco menos do que o banheiro externo e o quarto tinha cheiro de mofo.
Essa foi a PIOR experiência que tive em um hostel na minha vida. 
Não gosto de fazer avaliações negativas pois não quero prejudicar ninguém, mas também não posso deixar outras pessoas serem enganadas como fui.
Não acredite nas fotos, a realidade é bem diferente e para esse hostel ser considerado RUIM, ainda precisa melhorar muito!

analysis.negative_en: The hostel is dirty, messy and ugly. When you enter the hostel there is a cramped corridor full of luggage and there is no one to greet you. The receptionist is a remote attendant via a small screen, with no on-site manager to help. Entering the kitchen and common areas, things get much worse: everything is very dirty and chaotic, the kitchen is a mess and the fridges are so full it’s impossible to store even a bottle of water. I stayed in two rooms. The first room was freezing and there was no way to increase the air conditioning or complain to someone at the ghost hostel. The external bathroom, shared with the whole floor, was a complete mess—filthy. The second room was female-only, in what seemed to be an annex, and whenever someone walked by my bed would shake because the floor isn’t well supported. The bathroom was dirty too, but a bit less than the external bathroom, and the room smelled of mold. This was the worst experience I’ve had in a hostel. I don’t like leaving negative reviews because I don’t want to hurt anyone, but I can’t let others be misled as I was. Don’t trust the photos; the reality is very different and this hostel still has a long way to go to be considered bad.

reviews.title: A comfortable and clean stay with good privacy, but poor communication and limited facilities.
reviews.positive:
• Curtains and wall partitions provide privacy.
• No eating/drinking in bed room and quiet time after 10 p.m. make it peaceful.
• Free towels and hairdryers are convenient.($10 deposit ) 
• Clean for a backpackers hostel.
• Dinner portions are generous and filling.
• Simple but appreciated breakfast (toast, cereal, coffee, tea).
reviews.negative:
• Dinner must be booked by 4 p.m., but this wasn’t clearly mentioned.
• Tried to book dinner through the app they provided, but it didn’t work; only managed to reserve after contacting a different phone number sent after signing the contract.
• The phone number and email address listed in the contract didn’t work — no reply to messages, and the phone disconnects immediately.
• Only one ensuite bathroom for 14 women (7 bunk beds), which is too few.
• Extra shower room outside helps, but no power outlet for hairdryers.
• Each bed has two power outlets, but one is already used for the light, so only one is actually available.

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK HERE!!
reviews.positive: Not a thing. You could not pay me to stay here again.
reviews.negative:
FIRST RED FLAG, the reception staff are on a tiny tablet. They are not on site and most likely out of country, using a green screen of an  office setting to try and project some sort of professionalism.

SECOND RED FLAG, an older lady checked in before us and had specifically requested a female only room at a different Azzurro Hotel. They had overbooked, had zero beds left, and sent her to Darling Harbour location. She had to accept a room with males because when she requested a discount for the trouble, she was told you can stay at the original "hotel" (that was overbooked) or forfeit your payment because they dont offer refunds. 


THIRD RED FLAG, We had to get our bedding changed before we could even sit down after a 9 hour drive. There was hair and stains on the linen. NONE of the beds had been changed before our arrival.
The listing says it is a HOTEL. It is barely a hostel.
We booked a Private Room with shared toilet/shower, which reads as shared between the 4 people in the room. It is communal showers and toilets in the middle of the building. 
The room has an air-conditioner but the staff have the remote, for reasons unknown. We had to call and ask them to send the staff member to change the temperature because the AC was set to fan only. When they arrived, they acted like they couldnt work out the remote. We had to ask for the remote and change the settings ourselves 
The showers and toilets stank and were just nasty.
Do yourself a favour and steer well clear of Azzurro Hotel. The place is a joke.

issues.issue: reception on a tablet and not on site

reviews.positive: Honestly, not much this time. I've stayed here before and it was acceptable at the time, hence why I decided to give it a second chance. But after my second stay, I can definitely say never again.
reviews.negative:
The idea of a hostel with staff working offsite is such a stupid idea. Issues don't get resolved as they don’t respond to messages and they take no accountability. 
The locks are a joke at both entrance to hostel and room. Terribly designed and rarely work.
When you first enter the hostel, there's around 50-100 left bags of luggage just haphazardly dumped throughout the hostel foyer. Massive safety issue. Especially when power isn't working; which was the case when I arrived.
They enforce you to fill out lots of paperwork before arrival, fiat enough. But then do nothing to make sure guests are doing the right thing. In my room, had one person who had their phone speaker going for ages, ignoring other guests to turn it off. So no one got much sleep. To make matters worse, this person was leaving snotty tissues all over floor and also had a plate of food left lying in the room. Now I understand why there were so many cockroaches. But when I told staff, my messages were ignored.
Bathrooms and few and far between and don't indicate if someone is already inside. So once you do finally get to shower and/or go to the toilet, be prepared for droves of other guests continously trying to turn the knob to get in.
There's more but it's easier to just say go find a better hostel than this. Especially one that has staff actually in the building to help you.
reviews.partner_reply:
Dear Andrew,

Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your recent stay did not meet expectations, especially after previously having an acceptable experience with us.

We regret the issues you encountered regarding communication, security, cleanliness, and overall guest behavior. Your comments highlight important areas where we need to improve, including clearer enforcement of house rules, faster response to guest concerns, and better monitoring of shared spaces to ensure both safety and comfort.

Please know that your feedback has been noted and will be carefully reviewed with our management team. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your honesty, as it helps us work toward providing a better experience for future guests.

Best regards,
Azzurro Pod Hotel Team

reviews.title: I hated my stay here, do yourself a favour and book a YHA instead (the price isn't much different)
reviews.negative:
I booked a 2 night stay and  left after 1 night.
1) The photos look good and it has an overall good rating  calls itself a “Pod Hotel”- do not be fooled!  Price attractive includes breakfast and dinner, honestly I think you're better off booking into a lovely YHA and getting some bread or cereal yourself! My room wasn’t anything like the photos.
2) No staff at reception, communicate though a monitor screen. The luggage storage is an open room, not secure at all. Communal areas were smelly and dirty.
4) Location inconvenient getting to and from the hostel and quite a sketchy area
6) I had a 4 bed dorm to myself as no one else had booked but it was SO depressing in there. The room smelt of damp and it looked like there was mould on the curtains . I woke up with a chesty cough (also cold in there)
 7) The aircon was in the room set to 23 degrees, I asked staff at around 9pm and  they said there should be a remote in the room, there wasn’t so they said they’ll send someone. They 2 hours later (around 11pm) and I asked them to switch airon off  he refused saying it would get too hot. It was Autumn. He said to call if too cold, so I did they said someone will come. They came just before 1AM to switch it off. I was sleeping.
8) I did not want to stay another night so I left in the morning and was refused a refund for the night I wasn’t staying. I gave numerous opportunities to resolve this but I think it’s important to leave an honest review. I’ve stayed in many hostels internationally and I will take bad reviews with a pinch of salt if photos and rating seems good,  but I think this is the worst I’ve stayed in. The photos are very misleading, it looks nice on the photos but the reality is far from it. The vibe in terms of décor, smell, cleanliness and even other people there is SO depressing. I was so much happier when I went to a YHA instead.
9) Bathrooms are small, so get soaked and gross and not enough of them.
Limited characters so had to cut text out.The end.

reviews.title: Very disappointing. Not as nice as it's made out to be.
reviews.positive:
The food provided was fine. Simple breakfast of cheap cereal with milk, white bread for toast with either jam or peanut butter, and tea/coffee/juice. Dinner was pretty basic, like being on a school camp. Plenty of food to fill you up, but lacking in quality and nutrition.
The bed was reasonably comfortable, but a challenge getting into the top bunk.
reviews.negative:
Not very good. Surprised at the overall quite high ratings. The pictures were clearly taken when renovations were new and everything was crisp and nice. Now it's generally pretty run down and grotty. Everything's a little bit dirty, especially the bathrooms which definitely need a deep clean. Also some of the bathrooms have issues like broken showers. There is minimal storage options in the bedroom, some hooks and more/bigger cupboards would've been nice.
The bunk bed itself was nice enough to sleep in but limited beside fixtures (ie no shelf or fixed light) make it less than ideal.
Reception is entirely remote. The online check-in wasn't working when I arrived and was left waiting for someone to respond to my messages. Especially difficult when you've just arrived in the country and don't have proper phone/internet access yet. Also the need to upload signed pdf forms and ID to stay after payment and confirmation has come through its a nuisance.
All in all I felt like I'd walked into a poor house rather than a "hotel" as they call themselves. I understand it is cheap accommodation but don't get your hopes up. I was definitely disappointed and won't be staying here again except as a last resort.

reviews.negative:
Al no haber personal fisico en la recepcion, se colaba gente en las habitaciones con la reserva de otras personas. Hable con el personal de recepcion que estan virtualmente a traves de un ipad e intente que resolvieran el problema de tener muchas personas que sabian el codigo de entrada de mi habitacion y que eran desconocidos para ellos ya que no me sentia segura. Me mandaron una foto de la persona que habia hecho la reserva y les dije que esa no era la persona que estaba en mi habitacion. La solucion que me dieron es que me podian cambiar a una habitacion con mas personas en vez de investigar quien era el intruso o cambiarlo a el de habitacion y cambiar el codigo de entrada a la nuestra. 
Las fotos son del alojamiento cuando abrio, ahora todo estaba sucio, viejo y roto. 
La comida en las fotos parece un buffet pero es un plato que te sirven como si estuvieras en el comedor del colegio.
Una tarde me encontraba descansando en mi cama cuando entro el personal de limpieza en la habitacion porque se habian ido dos personas. No se dio cuenta de que yo estaba alli y pude ver claramente como estiraba las sabanas usadas de los anteriores huespedes y dedicaba el resto del tiempo a mirar su movil para luego salir sin haber cambiado nada. Esa noche vinieron dos personas nuevas y usaron las mismas sabanas que los anteriores.

analysis.negative_en: There was no physical staff at the reception, so people were sneaking into rooms with other guests’ reservations. I spoke with reception staff who are virtually via an iPad and asked them to resolve the issue of many people knowing the entry code to my room, who were strangers to them, which made me feel unsafe. They sent me a photo of the person who had made the reservation, and I told them that wasn’t the person in my room. The solution they offered was to move me to a room with more people instead of investigating who the intruder was or changing the entry code for ours. The photos show the accommodation as it was when it opened; now everything is dirty, old, and broken. The food in the photos looks like a buffet, but it’s a plate served as if you were in a school cafeteria. One afternoon I was resting on my bed when housekeeping entered the room because two people had left. They didn’t realize I was there, and I could clearly see how they pulled the used sheets from previous guests and spent the rest of the time on their phone, leaving without changing anything. That night two new people came in and used the same sheets as the previous ones.

issues.issue: investigate intruder and reset room codes

reviews.title: Cafards, moisissures et installations électriques dangereuses : une honte !
reviews.negative:
L’auberge est extrêmement sale et insalubre. Il y a des cafards dans les chambres (dont un qui m'a couru dessus pendant la nuit), ainsi que des insectes et de la moisissure partout dans les salles de bain. La cuisine est également dans un état déplorable, avec de la nourriture en train de pourrir et des moucherons partout. 
En plus du manque total d’hygiène, la sécurité laisse également à désirer : des multiprises sont branchées les unes sur les autres, créant un risque électrique et un potentiel danger d’incendie.
Un établissement aussi sale que dangereux, où les conditions d’hébergement sont tout simplement inacceptables et surtout : pas de remboursement ou de geste commercial malgré tout ça. 
Une expérience vraiment décevante, je ne recommande absolument pas cet établissement.

analysis.title_en: Cockroaches, mold and dangerous electrical installations: a disgrace!
analysis.negative_en:
The hostel is extremely dirty and unsanitary. There are cockroaches in the rooms (one even ran over me during the night), as well as insects and mold everywhere in the bathrooms. The kitchen is also in a deplorable state, with food rotting and fruit flies everywhere.
In addition to the total lack of hygiene, safety is also poor: power strips are plugged into each other, creating an electrical risk and a potential fire hazard.
An establishment that is both dirty and dangerous, where the accommodation conditions are simply unacceptable and, above all, no refund or goodwill gesture despite all this.
A truly disappointing experience, I would absolutely not recommend this place.

reviews.negative:
Начнем с заселения, приходит сообщение от отеля, что необходимо зарегистрироваться онлайн, но в сообщении нет никаких ссылок или QR кода для регистрации онлайн, я прилетел в Сидней и написал им в 1:30PM, с вопросом где регистрироваться онлайн, но ответа так и не поступило, хотя пишут что отвечают на сообщения в букинге и по почте своей, я решил ехать в отель. Приехал в отель в 3:00PM, на двери есть QR-код для регистрации, я зарегистрировался и перешел в приложение GOKI, но там сказано было что вы не зарегистрированы и соответственно нет никаких кодов для того, чтобы попасть в комнату и внутрь здания! В итоге я простоял на улице у двери в отель под дождем до практически 05:00PM, так как никто не отвечал на мои сообщения по почте, в букинге, в ватсап с 1:30PM! Ответили только ближе к 5 вечера, и пришлось ждать когда мне отправят коды от дверей! Причина в том, что якобы сотрудник не видел мои сообщения!!! В общем много времени потрачено впустую при онлайн заселении. 
По поводу хранения багажа, если вы привыкли оставлять в отеле, то это не ваш вариант, оставить можно только до полудня! И они могли бы пойти мне навстречу, с учетом того, что два часа я не мог попасть в свою комнату, но нет, мне отказали, можно только до полудня, а у меня вылет был вечером! Из-за проблем с регистрацией я не смог зарегистрироваться на ужин. По поводу чистоты, ну помойте вы уже окна в комнатах с «видом» на мост и оперу, там просто разглядеть надо все через эту грязь. В зоне кухни грязно, ремонт сделан приятный в светлых тонах, но везде грязь! Грязные раковины, зона готовки, в раковине еда, посуда не мытая! В общем сначала хотел забронировать еще на 6 ночей через неделю, но это того не стоит, поэтому передумал.

analysis.positive_en: The room was okay, with a view of the Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House. The location is good.
analysis.negative_en: Starting with check-in, the hotel sent a message that online registration was required, but there were no links or QR codes for online registration. I landed in Sydney and messaged them at 1:30 PM asking where to register online, but there was no reply, even though they say they respond to Booking messages and their emails. I decided to go to the hotel. Arrived at the hotel at 3:00 PM; there is a QR code at the door for registration, I registered and opened the GOKI app, but it showed that you are not registered and there were no codes to access the room or inside the building! I ended up waiting outside the hotel door in the rain until almost 5:00 PM, as no one answered my messages via email, Booking, or WhatsApp from 1:30 PM! They replied only closer to 5 PM and I had to wait for codes to be sent. The reason given was that an employee hadn’t seen my messages!!! In general, online check-in wasted a lot of time. Regarding luggage storage, if you’re used to leaving luggage at a hotel, this isn’t your option; you can only leave it until noon! And they could have been more flexible, considering I couldn’t access my room for two hours, but no, they refused, only until noon, and I had a flight in the evening! Because of the registration issues I couldn’t register for dinner. Regarding cleanliness, wash the windows in the rooms with views of the bridge and Opera House, they’re so dirty you can hardly see through. In the kitchen area it’s dirty; the renovation is pleasant in light colors, but everywhere is dirty! Dirty sinks, cooking area, food in the sink, dishes not washed! At first I planned to book another 6 nights in a week, but it’s not worth it, so I changed my mind.

reviews.positive:
I had stayed at this property several times last year, and while the customer service wasn’t always outstanding, I understood it’s a hostel environment. However, during one stay, I was placed right next to a bathroom, and there was constant door slamming throughout the night (2–4am). Understandably, I was frustrated and contacted reception via the intercom. Unfortunately, I was told there were no options to move rooms and that I would just have to put up with it.
The following morning, the manager informed me that I was no longer welcome, despite having stayed there for nearly two months the previous year and across multiple locations. I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted.
I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion.
I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times.
Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless.
Overall, the situation felt disproportionate and poorly handled. I was left confused, as the outcome didn’t seem to match the circumstances.

Problemen fortsatte under min sista natt. Trots att sängarna är tydligt numrerade hade personalen bäddat fel säng, vilket ledde till att mina saker återigen låg i en hög och att en annan gäst låg i min säng. Detta resulterade i att jag tvingades byta rum sista natten, vilket skapade onödigt krångel och stress. Sammantaget en mycket dålig upplevelse.
reviews.partner_reply:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience, and we’re very sorry to hear about the issues you encountered during your stay.

What you described regarding your bed being remade while still occupied, your belongings being moved, and the missing adapter is certainly not acceptable. We understand how frustrating and concerning this must have been. The situation you experienced on your last night, including the incorrect bed assignment and having to move rooms, should not have happened and we sincerely apologise for the inconvenience and stress caused.

This highlights a clear breakdown in communication between our teams, and we are addressing this internally to ensure better coordination and to prevent similar situations from happening again.

We’re also sorry that you felt unsupported when you raised these concerns at the time. That is not the level of service we aim to provide, and we will be following this up with our team.

Thank you again for your feedback—it’s very important to us as we work to improve both our service and guest experience.

Although the beds are clearly numbered, the staff had made up the wrong bed, which led to my things again being piled up and another guest sleeping in my bed. reviews.title: Buena estancia con algunas consideraciones típicas de hostel y de Sydney
reviews.positive: Shella ayuda mucho en el proceso de check-in virtual (el más largo que he visto hasta ahora). Desayuno y cena incluidos en la tarifa. Seguridad en el ingreso gracias al software Goki. Bastantes franceses y latinoamericanos, algunos son long-term, pero aún así muy sociables. Los baños eran limpiados diariamente, y al menos durante la mañana se veían muy bien debido a que han sido remodelados. La ubicación es excelente si te interesan las fiestas en la zona de Kings Cross (como La Cueva, una de las principales fiestas latinas de Sydney), muchos restaurantes cerca, y está a pocos metros de la estación de tren del mismo nombre que te lleva a la ciudad o a Bondi Junction (desde donde puedes tomar buses hacia Bondi Beach). Las literas son normales, ni duras ni muy cómodas.
reviews.negative: Roomies muy desordenados, dejaban todo tirado. A mi litera le faltaba la repisa para poner cosas que todas las demás sí tenían, y la luz personal estaba desconectada de la corriente (nunca hallé la toma correspondiente). Pocos baños para la cantidad de huéspedes, aunque esperable en una casa antigua reconvertida. La cena a menudo era carente de proteína, y la zanahoria en la ensalada era literalmente incomible por ser tan dura. Vi una cucaracha muerta en el comedor secundario y, al día siguiente, otra pequeña y mojada sobre la encimera. Muchos huecos sin tapar por donde otras cucarachas podrían colarse, aunque en fin, así es Sydney. El comedor principal al parecer se limpia semanalmente, porque siempre lo vi sucio. El camino a la lavandería está muy desordenado y luce bastante mal.

analysis.title_en: Good stay with some typical hostel and Sydney considerations.
analysis.positive_en: Shella helps a lot with the virtual check-in process. Breakfast and dinner included in the rate. Security at entry thanks to the Goki software. Plenty of French and Latin American guests, sociable even if long-term. Bathrooms were cleaned daily and looked good in the morning thanks to remodels. Excellent location for nightlife around Kings Cross, many restaurants nearby, and close to the station that goes to the city or Bondi Junction. Bunks are standard, not hard or overly comfy.
analysis.negative_en: Roommates were very messy, left things scattered. My bunk lacked a shelf to hold items that others had, and the personal light wasn’t connected to power (I could never find the corresponding outlet). Few bathrooms for the number of guests, though understandable in an old converted house. The dinner often lacked protein, and the carrot in the salad was so hard it was inedible. Saw a dead cockroach in the secondary dining room and the next day another small and damp one on the counter. Many gaps unsealed where more cockroaches could get in, though that’s Sydney for you. The main dining room seems to be cleaned weekly, because I always saw it dirty. The path to the laundry is very disorganized and looks quite bad.
analysis.urgent_reason: cockroaches present in dining areas and counter

reviews.title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
reviews.negative:
Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations.
There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion.
Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided.
On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag.
There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates.
Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning.
There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

reviews.negative: När vi kom till rummet var det ett HELT ANNAT rum än det som var på Booking. Det var otroligt mörkt, smutsigt och extremt slitet. AC:n var portabel och lät extremt mycket samtidigt som det gick en stor slang ut ur fönstret som var öppet. Det var slarvigt tejpat så fönstret hade fortfarande ett öppet hål längst ner. Detta bjöd in rök lukt från de som stod och rökte utanför entrén samt kackerlackor. Badrummen var otroligt smutsiga och det var svartmögel vart man än titta. Vi insåg direkt att vi hade blivit scammade och tog kontakt med ”receptionen” som var en person i en IPad i hallen. Det sa att det skulle titta på rummet vilket det gjorde, personalen som kolla sa att vi hade fått fel rum och att han höll med om att det absolut inte var samma rum. De sa att vi kunde byta till det rätta rummet dagen efter men INTE få återbetalt för natten i det hemska rummet vi hade. De sa även att det inte var återbetalningsbart trots att det inte appliceras i fall där kunden har blivit SCAMMAD. Till slut går det med på att återbetala om vi lämnar SAMMA KVÄLL, klockan var 20:00 och det var otroligt påfrestande. Vi fråga om det gick bra att byta till det rätta rummet morgonen efter då vi inte kunde hitta boende. ”Kundtjänst” sa då följande: Ni har fått rätt rum, alla de privata rummet ser ut så, bilderna på Booking är bara ”refrensbilder” - trots att de hade sagt att vi fick fel rum? Vi fick tag på Booking som hjälpte oss att få full återbetalning och vi lämnade samma kväll. Kort sagt, rummen ser inte ALLS ut som de gör på bilderna och jag avråder samtliga personer från att bo här.

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologise for the negative experience you had during your stay. We understand how upsetting it must have been to feel that the room did not meet your expectations and to experience issues with cleanliness, AC, and overall comfort.

We also regret the confusion regarding the room assignment and any miscommunication about the photos on Booking.com. Our intention is never to mislead guests — the images are meant to represent the room type generally, but we acknowledge that this may not have reflected your specific room accurately, and we are reviewing our listings to prevent similar misunderstandings.

We are glad that our team and Booking.com were able to assist with a full refund and resolve the situation, but we sincerely apologise for the stress caused. Your feedback is extremely important, and we will use it to improve our room presentation, maintenance, and guest communication going forward.

Thank you for bringing these concerns to our attention.

analysis.negative_en: When we arrived, the room was a completely different room from what was shown on Booking. It was incredibly dark, dirty and extremely worn. The AC was portable and very loud, with a large hose coming out of the window which was open. It was sloppily taped so the window still had a hole at the bottom. This invited the smell of smoke from outside and cockroaches. The bathrooms were incredibly dirty and there was black mold wherever you looked. We immediately realized we had been scammed and contacted the 'reception' who was a person on an iPad in the hall. They said they would look at the room, which they did; the staff who checked said we had gotten the wrong room and agreed it was not the same room. They said we could switch to the correct room the next day but NOT get a refund for the night in the horrible room we had. They also said it was non-refundable despite it not applying in cases where the customer has been SCAMMED. In the end they agreed to refund if we left the same evening; it was incredibly stressful. We asked if it would be okay to switch to the correct room the morning after since we could not find other accommodation. 'Customer service' then responded: You have gotten the right room, all private rooms look like that, the pictures on Booking are only 'reference pictures' - even though they had told us we got the wrong room? We contacted Booking, who helped us get a full refund and we left the same evening. In short, the rooms do NOT look like the pictures at all and I would discourage everyone from staying here.

reviews.positive: I did not like anything
reviews.negative:
This is by far the worst hostel I’ve ever stayed at in my life! Dirty, smelly… the room stank so bad I could barely sleep. There’s only one women’s bathroom with 2 toilets and 2 showers—for the entire hostel! No security, no privacy. The kitchen was disgusting: dirty pots, plates, cups, everything! People leave a mess and there’s nobody to clean it up. There’s no reception—just one person online talking to you through a camera and a computer screen.

The ad claims the rooms have air conditioning—total lie! The room is hot, the bed is terrible. There’s not a single common area. Just a filthy kitchen with a table and chairs, and some weird cubicle with benches. So forget trying to arrive early, relax, charge your phone, hang out, or meet anyone—impossible!

Rotten place. I would never go back, I’d rather sleep in the subway. I paid way too much because they lie in their ads, while there are so many better, cheaper hostels with friendly, attentive staff. I already know hostel service in Australia can be poor, but this place took mediocrity to a whole new level.

My advice? Don’t stay here—unless you want to punish yourself, or hope they either go out of business or actually improve. Total trash.

At checkout, I was out of the room early, but I had a few trips up and down the stairs to take my suitcase and backpacks and they changed the code to gate and room and it was a struggle to get my stuff. Just give a 20 minutes window?! We are leaving, Jezzzz. Food seems to be like a little buffet from the pictures but it isn't. I do not recommend it if you have allergies, it doesn't seem like the place who would be able to respect cross contamination and so on. Also with the condition of the kitchen, I didn't feel like eating there either. Bring some good earplugs cause the AC will scream if turned on.
There's no in person receptionist, just remotely through the screen. 

If you're on a budget, it's fine, it's also close to the metro and it's easy to get there from the airport.

Bagni imbarazzanti, sporchi, e la struttura in brutte condizioni in generale, non ne vale assolutamente la pena per il prezzo.
Nei bagni non c’è né sapone né carta per asciugarsi le mani, posso capire la carta se c’è un bagno per ogni stanza e ognuno ha la propria asciugamano, ma qui c’è un bagno generale per tutte le donne al piano terra, e il sapone era totalmente assente, NON era il contenitore ad essere vuoto, e io queste cose basilari non le faccio nemmeno presenti allo staff sinceramente, mi è venuto un brivido a pensare a tutte le persone che vanno in bagno, non si lavano le mani e magari vanno in cucina, toccano posate, eccetera.

reviews.title: Das Hostel an sich ist sehr sozial, ich persönlich habe mich aber im gesamten Umfeld nicht wohlgefühlt.
reviews.positive:
An sich war das Bett sauber und bequem. Auch das Zimmer war groß, sodass es kein Problem war sich das Zimmer mit 5 weiteren Personen zu teilen. 
Das gemeinsame Frühstück & Abendessen hat dafür gesorgt, dass man immer wieder mit den Leuten in Kontakt kam, somit hinterließ das Hostel für mich einen eigentlich sehr sozialen Eindruck. Außerdem konnte man durch das Essen, was in Ordnung war, echt etwas Geld sparen - also gerade für Low-Budget Traveller eine gute Sache!
reviews.negative: Leider erweckte das Hostel auf mich den Eindruck, als würde man sich nicht so wirklich drum kümmern. Viele Küchenschränke, Schlösser, Türklinken… waren kaputt und teils war es leider (bis auf das Bett) auch nicht sehr sauber. Gerade die Küche war eher etwas chaotisch. Zudem wirkt auch der Außenbereich nicht so gepflegt und definitiv nicht so wie auf den Bildern. Vor dem Hostel haben sich teilweise sehr suspekte Menschen versammelt, wodurch ich mich selbst, gerade abends, einfach nicht so wohl gefühlt habe. Oftmals hat unser Zimmer abends deshalb auch sehr nach Gras gerochen, da diese Leute eben vor der Tür gekifft haben - für mich persönlich nicht so angenehm und hat nicht dafür gesorgt, dass ich mich wohl gefühlt habe.

analysis.title_en: The hostel itself is very social, but I personally didn't feel comfortable in the overall environment.
analysis.positive_en: Overall the bed was clean and comfortable. The room was large, so sharing the room with 5 other people wasn’t a problem. The shared breakfast and dinner helped you meet people, leaving a generally very social impression of the hostel. Also, the food, which was fine, saved you some money—especially for low-budget travelers.
analysis.negative_en: Unfortunately, the hostel gave me the impression that it wasn’t being looked after. Many kitchen cabinets, locks, and door handles were broken and, aside from the bed, it wasn’t very clean. The kitchen in particular felt chaotic. The outdoor area also didn’t look well kept and certainly not as shown in the pictures. In front of the hostel, there were sometimes very suspicious people gathered, which made me feel uncomfortable, especially in the evenings. Our room often smelled strongly of cannabis in the evenings because these people were smoking outside the door, which I didn’t like and it didn’t make me feel comfortable.

reviews.title: Nie wieder werde ich diese Unterkunft buchen!
reviews.positive: Die Lage war gut.
reviews.negative:
Der Check-in erfolgt nicht persönlich, sondern über eine Rezeptionistin per Video. Der uns mitgeteilte Code für die Zimmertür funktionierte nicht, auch der zweite Code ermöglichte keinen Zugang zum Zimmer. Der Hausmeister öffnete uns nach einiger Zeit die Tür, wir konnten das Zimmer aber nicht mehr verlassen, da der Code nicht funktionierte. Ein weiterer Gast, welchen ich um Hilfe bat, sagte aus, dass auch sein Zimmercode nicht funktioniere und er deshalb ständig einen Schuh in die Zimmertür stellen musste, damit ihm der Eintritt jederzeit möglich war. Zudem wurden wir um 21.30 Uhr von einem Angestellten aufgefordert, die Zimmertür zu öffnen, denn er wollte an der Decke einen Rauchmelder installieren. Er erklärte es sei ein Notfall, wir hörten die Bohrmaschine aus den Nebenzimmern. Erst nach mehrmaligem intensiven Verneinen unsererseits entfernte sich der Angestellte und ließ uns schlussendlich in Ruhe.
Das Zimmer war extrem klein (2x3m)und man konnte sich kaum umdrehen, da die Koffer auf dem Boden ausgepackt werden mussten.
Der Preis war meiner Meinung nicht gerechtfertigt, es fehlte auch die Sauberkeit und ein einfacher angemessener Komfort.

analysis.title_en: I will never book this accommodation again!
analysis.positive_en: The location was good.
analysis.negative_en: The check-in is not done in person but via a receptionist over video. The door code for the room did not work, the second code also did not grant access to the room. The maintenance man opened the door after some time, but we could not leave the room because the code still didn’t work. Another guest told me his code also didn’t work, and he had to put a shoe in the door to enter at all times. At 21:30 a staff member asked us to open the door because he wanted to install a smoke detector on the ceiling. He explained it was an emergency; we heard the drill from the neighboring rooms. Only after we strongly refused several times did the staff member leave us alone. The room was extremely small (2x3 m) and you could hardly turn around since the suitcases had to be unpacked on the floor. In my opinion the price was not justified, and there was a lack of cleanliness and simple reasonable comfort.

analysis.title_en: Poor hostel – the photos are the only good thing
analysis.positive_en: Very good location. Close to the park and the opera.
analysis.negative_en: Photos do not reflect what is there. The hostel is old and neglected. The fridges are sticky with dirt. There was always a problem with the bathrooms because there are too few. Breakfast is standard for a hostel. Dinner looks nice in the photo but it’s not a buffet: when we were there it was pasta with cheese and salad and the staff serve portions. The patio in photos looks great but in reality it looks like no one has looked after it for a long time. The room is a disaster: advertised as 12 m2 but in reality it was 6 m2, and you can’t even use the sink because it’s blocked by a bed. Overall, even if the price is low, photos should reflect reality – they are terribly exaggerated.

Il n'y a pas de réception, simplement une tablette parfois activée et parfois éteinte donc si vous arrivez au mauvais moment c'est tant pis pour vous.
Aucun espace de vie commune pour faire des rencontres. Les chambres ne sont pas nettoyées correctement.
Plus grave encore : l'absence de sécurité. Les portes d'entrée sont souvent grandes ouvertes le soir alors que ce quartier n'est vraiment pas sûr.
Pendant mon séjour, un sans abri s'est introduit dans la chambre d'une amie...
Bref, je déconseille fortement cet établissement

reviews.title: Nice hostel, but poor food, and no on-site staff.
reviews.positive:
Positives : 
- 3 mins walk to Kings Cross station
- cooking facilities available.
- laundry was $4AUD for wash and the same for the drier.
reviews.negative:
Negatives :
- no staff on site - all comms are online, or via a video call on a monitor at the entrance
- dinner is awful. Truly bad. We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken.
- Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight.
- The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make. 
- there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times.


Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.

issues.issue: breakfast not available on time / basic
dinner timing advertised 6:30pm but available from 7:30pm

reviews.positive: Dobrá lokalita v docházkové vzdálenosti do centra města.
reviews.negative:
Lokalita je sice v blízkosti centra, ale k ubytování vedou dlouhé schody, takže lidé s kufry by měli raději přijet autem. Přijela jsem a neměla ani data ani wifi a ke vstupu do ubytování byl potřeba online check-in zvenku dveří. Naštěstí mě někdo pustil dovnitř a připojila jsem se na wifi a dokončila check-in uvnitř (předtím mi žádné takové informace nepřišly). V ubytování je na pokojích málo místa pro zavazadla a zdálo se, že řada osob zde i bydlí trvale (slečna ve stejném pokoji jako já, nebo muž,  který pracoval pro roznáškovou službu na jídlo a pak si suverénně do ubytování odemkl a šel na pokoj). Byla jsem z ubytování trochu zklamaná, hlavně z check-inu, prvního dojmu v nehezké vstupní hale a pak ze slečny u nás na pokoji, která byla nemocná a 24/7 spala, chrápala nebo kašlala (to ale chápu, že se nedá ovlivnit a patří to k hostelu). 
Zásuvky byly všechny již zabrané, ale stačilo jen odpojit lampičku v posteli a do toho si dát vlastní nabíječku.

analysis.positive_en: Good location within walking distance to the city center.
analysis.negative_en: The location is close to the center, but there are long stairs to the accommodation, so people with luggage would be better off arriving by car. I arrived and had no data or wifi and online check-in from outside the door was required. Fortunately someone let me in and I connected to wifi and completed check-in inside (before that I didn’t receive such information). There is little space for luggage in the rooms and it seemed that several people live there permanently (a girl in the same room as me, or a man who worked for a food delivery service and then unlocked into the accommodation and went to the room). I was a bit disappointed with the accommodation, mainly with check-in, the first impression in an unattractive lobby and then with the girl in our room who was sick and slept 24/7, snored or coughed (which I understand cannot be helped and belongs to the hostel). The outlets were all already taken, but it was enough to unplug the bedside lamp and use my own charger.

reviews.positive:
The location is excellent—just a few minutes’ walk from Kings Cross Station, and within walking distance to the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Art Gallery of NSW, the State Library, and even the Sydney Opera House, all under 30 minutes away.

The included dinner is a nice bonus and much appreciated. However, during my 6-night stay, the menu was quite repetitive (two nights of pasta and four nights of biryani). A bit more variety would definitely improve the experience.

The area feels safe, and the location alone makes this place a convenient base for exploring Sydney. With a few adjustments, especially around dining options and room amenities, this could be an even better stay.
reviews.negative:
The hostel does not have a lift, and the hallways are very narrow, which makes moving around with luggage a bit difficult. The shower/toilet and common areas also feel quite cramped. At night, when the kitchen is closed, the only available common space is very small, so it may not be ideal for those who need to do remote work while traveling.

Another small inconvenience is that there are no hooks in the rooms for towels or other items.

reviews.partner_reply:
Hello Emma,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We’re glad to know you appreciated the privacy of the beds with curtains. At the same time, we’re truly sorry for the inconvenience caused by the laundry noise and the challenges of accessing the room and toilets, especially during rainy weather.

We appreciate you raising the issue about the laundry use at night — thanks to your feedback, we have since adjusted the laundry hours to prevent disturbances for future guests. Regarding the access and toilet facilities, we understand how this impacted your stay and will keep your feedback in mind as we look at ways to improve guest comfort.

Your comments are very valuable to us, and we thank you again for helping us improve.

Best regards,
Azzurro Hotels

analysis.positive_en: It was nice that the beds had curtains. analysis.negative_en: For our room you had to go outside, which was not very pleasant in the rain since you first have to enter a code before the door opens. For the toilet you also have to go outside and then go up the stairs; there are really far too few toilets for the number of people staying. We were opposite the laundry room and people kept running the washing machine all night, which caused a lot of noise.

reviews.negative:
Il n'y a pas de réception, quand vous arrivez vous devez vous adresser à une tablette en espérant que quelqu'un réponde.
L'auberge est insalubre. La façade est en écroulement. Tout est sale. Les salles de bains sont répugnantes. 
Pendant mon séjour d'un mois et demi quelqu'un à fait caca dans les douches publiques 3 FOIS avant d'être renvoyé... Plusieurs personnes sans domicile ont dormi à l'auberge gratuitement, parfois dans des lits qui étaient loués.
L'équipe du houskeeping est désagréable avec tout le monde, sans raison. 

Je déconseille cet établissement à n'importe qui peu importe le contexte.
À fuir.

reviews.title: Filme de terror
reviews.positive: Só a localização vale a pena.
reviews.negative:
Não tem placa identificando o local. O atendimento é virtual. Uma moça te atende por vídeo. Péssimo atendimento, por sinal. Fui com minha mãe e colocaram a gente em um quarto misto onde um casal habitava há meses, as coisas deles todas espalhadas pelo chão. Isso porque eu especificamente havia requerido um quarto exclusivo para mulheres para minha mãe. Não conseguiram e nem resolveram esse problema. 

O banheiro estava frequentemente sujo e está precisando de reforma. Em uma das noites, um grupo de hóspedes começou a gritar e cantar no quarto ao lado, estilo karaoke. Durou uma hora. E não havia ninguém no hostel para fazer alguma coisa a respeito. Foi a minha pior experiência em hostels na minha vida. Piora: acompanhado pela minha mãe aventureira pela primeira vez. 

Não acreditem nas fotos bem produzidas. Elas também me enganaram. A vista que prometem da ponte, é por uma janela ao lado da pia do lavabo do quarto. Uma piada. 

Enfim... é sujo, lotado, barulhento e mal organizado.

reviews.title: Great experience at Azzurro
reviews.positive:
I loved staying at Azzurro. The location is one of the best in the whole city, it has a beautiful view of the Opera House and it's close to a lot of useful establishments for students and backpackers, such as the Kings Cross library, the Kings Cross train station, supermarkets, grocery stores, washing house, pubs, restaurants and more.

The hostel fulfills the proposal of being a non party hostel. Despite that, this is the perfect place to be surrounded by people from several countries and it's very easy to make friends, people are very kind and friendly.

The beds are very comfortable, mostly because of the bedding set and the curtains they have in it.

The staff is great, they are friendly and whatever you need they will help.
reviews.negative:
The common areas are not very clean, especially the tables, and there's not much space to put your supermarket things in the storerooms or in the fridges, so try not to buy a lot of things!!!

The hostel is not responsible for your belongings, so keep a careful eye to your belongings, mostly small things, for example, jewelery or your umbrella, because people will steal it. I'm not saying this is a characteristic of this hostel. It could happen anywhere, but be careful. 

The food could be better and have more meal variations, but, at least, they are very generous about it, so it's impossible to starve.

issues.issue: great location with Opera House view
little storage space in storerooms and fridges
risk of theft; not responsible for belongings

Die Zimmertür geht nach draußen zum Innenhof welcher sehr verdreckt und heruntergekommen ist ( Müll, alte Zahnbürsten etc.) und hat eine Riesenspalte gehabt. Auch die Toiletten befanden sich im Hinterhof weshalb man auch hier immer durch den Regen musste. Die Check In Zeit ist sehr unflexibel obwohl Zimmer fertig sind. Punkt 15:00 bekommt man den Zimmer Code. Das Frühstück besteht aus weißen Toast und 2 Marmeladen + Instantkaffee. In der Küche ist es nicht sauber und man möchte kaum hier Frühstücken. analysis.positive_en: Good location with metro access
analysis.negative_en: The entire building is in quite poor condition. During my August stay it was 12 degrees at night; there is no heating and I was freezing. The room door opens to the inner courtyard which is very dirty and derelict (trash, old toothbrushes, etc.) and had a large gap. The toilets were located in the back courtyard, so you always had to walk through the rain. The check-in time is very inflexible although the rooms are ready. At 15:00 you get the room code. Breakfast consists of white toast and 2 jams plus instant coffee. The kitchen is not clean and you hardly want to have breakfast here. I skipped dinner as a result. I checked out after one night.

reviews.negative:
Honestly, I never thought I'd write a bad review but I'm quite disappointed at this point. I was given a room in the basement which was fine but it was quite stuffy and it smelt very damp. They gave me a new room but I had to pay an upgrade. The new room was a bit better but still smelt. There wasn't any staff, just a virtual receptionist which is fine but makes it a little harder to speak to someone. Most people there seem to be inbetween jobs/working which is also fine but not the vibe I was looking for (everyone I met was lovely though). By this point I was tempted to leave. 
The last thing that made me leave was when I pulled the curtain in my bed to get out, it fell and hit my face. It hurt! I spoke to them over WhatsApp and they were very apologetic. However, no one got back to me about a resolution and to be honest I never expect a refund or anything but was quite fed up by this point and just disappointed no one got back to me even after reminding them. I hate writing bad reviews and understand hostels are hostels but I do expect the basics to be decent at least. I waited a while before writing this but I needed to be honest.

ROOM

+Has a shelf

BATHROOM

STAFF

KITCHEN/MEALS

No pods.
Not a hotel.

ROOM

**I'll try to provide a photo, but booking rarely uploads the photos, so I'll post it on Google maps as well.

-bunk beds (NOT PODS) are old. Lumpy mattress and pillow. 

-the shelf is nowhere near the outlet (a rigged extension cord) so my phone couldn't be on the shelf while charging at night. Which defeats the purpose of the shelf. 

STAFF/LOBBY

KITCHEN/MEALS

reviews.title: Décevant et à éviter – vol dans notre chambre et mauvaises prestations globales
reviews.positive: Le positif : Les matelas sont confortables, les douches et toilettes sont propres, et l’équipe est réactive sur WhatsApp. Le petit-déjeuner est très basique mais correct.
reviews.negative:
Nous avons séjourné dans une chambre double privée pendant plusieurs nuits et avons été très déçus.

🔒 Sécurité : De la nourriture a été volée directement dans notre chambre pendant notre absence. Il n’y a que le personnel de ménage qui avait le code de la porte. Aucune solution ni compensation proposée. C’est inadmissible.

 Repas inclus : Nous avons mangé la même chose tous les soirs pendant 6 jours : pâtes à la tomate et riz au curry avec un peu de poulet. Pour le prix, on aurait pu faire nos courses, manger plus varié et pour moins cher.

 Confort de la chambre : Pas de vraies fenêtres fermées, seulement des dalles pivotantes en verre, donc bruit constant. Le store restait fermé car la fenêtre donnait directement sur un passage. Il y avait aussi un trou pour la ventilation, ce qui n’aide pas au calme.

 Nuisances sonores : L’insonorisation est inexistante. On entend tout : les gens dans les escaliers extérieurs (Butlers Stairs), les discussions, les joints fumés juste en bas de la fenêtre, comme s’ils étaient dans la chambre. Impossible de dormir sans bouchons d’oreilles.

Cuisine commune : Une seule plaque, pas assez de vaisselle (manque de mugs notamment), et peu de respect des règles (vaisselle sale non rangée, etc.). Et on y était en basse saison.

En résumé : Le rapport qualité-prix est très mauvais. Pour le même prix (voire moins cher), on aurait eu bien mieux dans un petit appartement avec cuisine. Nous ne recommandons pas du tout cet établissement.

analysis.title_en: Disappointing and to avoid – theft in our room and overall poor service
analysis.positive_en: The positives: The mattresses are comfortable, the showers and toilets are clean, and the team is responsive on WhatsApp. Breakfast is very basic but decent.
analysis.negative_en: We stayed in a private double room for several nights and were very disappointed. Security: Food was stolen directly from our room in our absence. Only the cleaning staff had the door code. No solution or compensation offered. This is unacceptable. Meals included: We ate the same thing every evening for 6 days: tomato pasta and curry rice with a bit of chicken. For the price, we could have shopped and eaten more varied for less. Room comfort: No real closed windows, only rotating glass panels, so constant noise. The blind stayed closed because the window opened onto a passage. There was also a ventilation hole, which does not help with quiet. Noise: Soundproofing is non-existent. We can hear people in the exterior stairs, conversations, joints smoked right below the window, as if they were in the room. Impossible to sleep without earplugs. Shared kitchen: Only one stove, not enough dishes (missing mugs), and little respect for rules (dirty dishes not put away), and we were there in the off-season. In short: value for money is very poor. For the same price we could have had a small apartment with a kitchen. We do not recommend this establishment at all.
analysis.urgent_reason: theft in room; potential security breach

reviews.title: Budget option for warmer days
reviews.positive:
The included breakfast and optional dinner are definitely highlights – breakfast is simple but sufficient, and the pre-order dinner is a convenient way to ensure a proper meal. The dinner I had was actually very good, and it’s a great benefit to have this option directly at the hostel.

The location is a plus – like most hostels around King’s Cross, there’s a terrace with a nice view of the Harbour Bridge.
That said, the overall experience might be more pleasant in warmer seasons.
reviews.negative:
However, one evening I asked for seconds, and the main cook told us to come back in 20 minutes. I waited over 30 minutes, and each time I approached, he just said “wait, wait” and served others instead. Eventually, there was nothing left, and I had to go out and buy food elsewhere – which felt like a big minus.

The room I stayed in was in the basement, quite cold and not very well insulated. I can’t imagine staying there during winter. The room was spacious, but everything creaked, and there was no power outlet for the upper bunk.
Also, the place felt dimly lit, which made it hard to find at first. The hostel operates in two separate buildings, but it’s not clear where you’re staying. After booking on Booking.com, you still need to register on the hostel’s website and then check in again at reception – which is unnecessarily complicated.

There is no larger lounge area in the accommodation where you can work or relax. Only an extended version of the dining room, which was always dirty, at least during my stay.

Overall, a fair option for travelers on a budget – especially during warmer days – but be prepared for some practical discomforts.

reviews.positive:
This bathroom is an absolute disgrace. It looks like it hasn’t seen a proper clean or maintenance check in years. The tiles are stained and moldy, the floor is constantly wet and filthy, and the overall hygiene is frankly unacceptable. The shower area is particularly grim. There’s mold in the corners, grime in the grout, and a general stench of neglect.

The most ridiculous part? The “window.” There is no window. Just a wide open hole in the wall with rusted bars and a pathetic sign that says “Do not close the window.” Close what, exactly? The glass is completely gone. It is just an open gap to a dirty wall outside, with zero privacy and zero protection.

To make matters worse, I checked out four days early and received no compensation, refund, or even acknowledgment. I left the property well before my original check-out date, and despite following all proper procedures, no one offered any kind of reimbursement or explanation.

This isn’t just run-down. It shows a complete lack of care. It is one of those places you walk into and instantly regret. Avoid it if you have any choice.

reviews.positive: I stayed here for just one night during a quick trip to Sydney to catch up with a friend, and honestly, I was really impressed by how smooth and comfortable everything was, even in such a short stay. The check-in process was fully online, and while there wasn’t anyone at a physical front desk, the staff were super responsive through chat and email. I had a couple of small questions before arrival, and they replied within minutes. All the instructions were clear, and I had no issues getting in — key codes and access were all sent in advance. The location is absolutely perfect — just a few minutes walk from a supermarket, and loads of cute cafes, takeaway places, and late-night food nearby. I even found a great bubble tea nearby! Even though I only stayed one night, I could tell this place is very thoughtfully set up for travelers — especially solo travelers like me. The room was quiet, clean, and the bed was actually really comfortable, with privacy curtains on each bed, personal charging ports, and lockers. I also loved the rooftop terrace — even in a short stay, I managed to catch the sunset there. It's a beautiful space. The Wi-Fi was strong and reliable, even in the room.

Also the aircon is so loud so you may struggle to sleep with it on but then the room is very stuffy and hot without it.

reviews.title: Crackden vibes
reviews.positive:
Location was really good and we enjoyed the inclusion of food but these were the only good things about this property.

Vastly different from the photos, it felt like staying in a crackden, our twin room was outside in what reminded me of a prison room. The front door was left open at all times during the day which meant anyone could’ve walked in or out and with no staff actually on site (you can see someone on an iPad near the door) if someone had walked in that shouldn’t be there, there was literally no one to stop them.

The kitchen/dining areas were consistently gross and I’m glad breakfast and dinner were provided as I wouldn’t want to cook in them. The food for breakfast and dinner was good, although you have to book for dinner. On our first night we booked via the link given to us after I did our online check in however we weren’t on the list. The staff member serving food was really rude to us but I argued it and showed them the booking and we ended up being given tiny portions. On another day I saw them turn a girl away who had probably done the same thing! 

The outside chill out area is actually nice and has a good view of the harbour and the opera house. The location was really good, Potts Point itself is lovely and the walk from the hostel through the botanic gardens towards the main area was great.

The place overall has a very unfriendly vibe, there’s signs everywhere saying there’s cameras and if they see people stealing they will call the police. This was no joke as in one tiny dining room there were 6 cameras!! There’s also signs everywhere saying no talking/phone calling in the rooms. I understand completely about being respectful but this was extreme as it said anyone reported to be talking in the rooms would be ejected. 

Overall it did our budget some good but I wouldn’t stay again. In our 7 months of (worldwide) travelling probably our least favourite place!

issues.issue: twin room outside in prison-like room
front door left open all day
