overly strict camera surveillance and no talking in rooms

reviews.title: I’d definitely consider staying here again, even for leisure. Highly recommend!
reviews.positive:
I stayed at Potts Point for just one night as part of a longer business trip across Australia, and I was genuinely impressed by how comfortable and convenient the experience was.

The location is truly ideal—quiet and charming, yet still close to the action. It's just a short walk to the Town Hall station, which made getting around the city incredibly easy. I even managed to squeeze in a quick visit to Bondi Beach, which was only a few rides away—perfect for unwinding after a full day of meetings.

The hostel itself is well-designed and thoughtfully maintained. The backyard and dining area stood out to me as peaceful spots where you could relax, grab a cup of coffee, or get some work done if needed. It was clear that the staff take pride in keeping the place clean and organized—my private room was spotless, and the shared areas were tidy and welcoming.

Special mention goes to the receptionist, who was not only polite and professional but also very efficient. After a long day of travel and work, I appreciated how quick and smooth the check-in process was. They also gave great recommendations for nearby places to eat and how to get around easily.

All in all, Potts Point Hostel exceeded my expectations, especially for a short business stop. It’s a great blend of comfort, cleanliness, and location, with a touch of character that makes you feel more at home than in a typical hotel.
reviews.negative: My only minor observation was that during dinner time, the dining area got a little crowded, and a few more seats would have been helpful.

Frühstück ist zwar einfach, aber ausreichend: Kaffee, Tee, Toast, Margarine, Marmelade, Müsli..

analysis.positive_en: Value for money is good. Beds are comfortable and equipped with curtains. A backpack fits under the bed easily, and there is a locker that can be locked with a personal padlock. Breakfast is simple but sufficient: coffee, tea, toast, margarine, jam, muesli. Dinner is okay but not very varied (2 days rice with salad and chicken, 1 day pasta with tomato sauce). Shared showers are relatively tight, which makes getting dressed a bit difficult. In the room there is little space to hang clothes or towels. Towels are only available for a fee. Check-in is possible online. Somewhat hidden on the website are infos about an app through which doors can be opened and dinner can be booked. Location is good. About a 20-minute walk to the city center. About 5 minutes away is a metro station.

reviews.positive: Zentral gelegen, sauber, freundliches & hilfsbereites Personal
reviews.negative:
Die Fotos auf Booking sind offenbar schon etwas älter. 

Mein Schlafsaal hatte kein richtiges Fenster, daher dunkel und schnell stickig, wenn man die AC nicht dauerhaft laufen.ließ. Die AC war super laut, dazu eine sehr hellhörige Zimmerdecke. Die Betten im Schlafsaal und auch der Boden quietschen, sobald sich jemand bewegte Der Schlaf in den vier Nächten war für mich daher leider nicht erholsam, die Nächte kurz.

 Im Nebenhaus, in dem auch mein Schlafsaal war, haben alle Schlafsäle insgesamt nur zwei! Badezimmer mit jeweils nur einer Dusche und einer Toilette, was regelmäßig zu Warteschlangen führte - auch wenn man nur auf die Toilette musste. Alternativ muss man das Nebenhaus verlassen, auf die Straße gehen und dann zum Haupthaus nebenan laufen. 

Das inklusive Abendessen empfand ich als eintönig:  Es bestand fast täglich aus Reis, etwas Salat  (auch immer gleich) und dann alternativ Fleisch/vegetarisches Schnitzel.

Kurzum: Da ist noch deutlich Luft nach oben.

analysis.positive_en: Central location, clean, friendly and helpful staff.
analysis.negative_en: The photos on Booking are apparently a bit older. My dormitory had no proper window, so it was dark and quickly stuffy unless the AC was kept running. The AC was very loud, and the room ceiling was very creaky. The beds in the dorm and the floor creak whenever anyone moves, so the sleep for four nights wasn't restful. In the annex, which also housed my dorm, there are only two bathrooms in total, each with only one shower and one toilet, which regularly led to queues—even if you only had to use the toilet. Alternatively you have to leave the annex, go out onto the street and then walk to the main building next door. In short: there is still clearly room for improvement.

reviews.title: Quantité n'est pas égal à qualité...
reviews.positive: J'imagine que pour des personnes en working holiday c'est un bon moyen d'économiser de l'argent. Mais en tant que voyageurs il y a des hostels beaucoup mieux pour le même prix ou moins cher.
reviews.negative:
Pas de réception sur place, tout se fait par WhatsApp et les seules personnes qui travaillent sont celles qui viennent pour nettoyer mais elles sont en général pas au courant de chose lier au fonctionnement de l'hôtel.
Donc si vous chercher des bons conseils pour visiter Sydney c'est clairement pas ici que vous les aurez.

Avant même d'arriver j'ai senti le genre d'hôstel: après avoir lu de nombreux commentaires négatifs, j'ai souhaité annuler ma réservation. Comme cela n'est pas proposé dans leurs options quand on réserve, booking a fait une demande à l'hôstel, leur laissant donc le choix d'accéder à ma demande, mais ils ont refusé me disant que c'était le fonctionnement de booking (alors que booking leur laisser le choix). En gros ce qui compte c'est leur argent, pas la satisfaction client.

Ensuite, le jour de mon arrivée, je n'ai pas pu manger le soir car je n'avais pas réservé pour le repas, sachant que la réservation doit se faire avant 16h, que l'on découvre ça une fois que l'on a fait le check in, donc pour ceux qui font un check in après 16h ne comptez pas sur un repas le premier soir.

Les petits déjeuners sont basiques: pain blanc, peanut butter, confiture et café soluble.

Les espaces communs ne sont pas très agréables et donc pas propices pour rencontrer du monde. La terrasse qui avait l'air très chouette sur les photos est en pente et donne sur une palissade en bois (donc oublié la jolie vue derrière). Et vous y rencontrerez de nombreux cafards.

Les lits sont corrects mais il n'y a pas de quoi ouvrir les fenêtres et il fait donc très chaud dans les chambres. Et les clims sont supers bruyantes. Donc au choix: on meurt de chaud où on dort dans le bruit.

Au passage, le dortoir 6 places pour femme dans lequel j'étais est en sous sol avec une grande fenêtre donnant sur la rue, sans rideau, d'où n'importe qui peut donc nous voir.

analysis.title_en: Quantity is not equal to quality...
analysis.positive_en: I suppose that for people on working holidays it's a good way to save money. But as travelers there are hostels much better for the same price or cheaper.
analysis.negative_en: No on-site reception; everything is done via WhatsApp and the only staff who seem to work are the cleaners, who are usually not aware of how the hotel operates. So if you're looking for good tips to visit Sydney, you're not going to get them here. Before arriving I sensed the kind of hostel it was; after reading many negative comments, I wanted to cancel my reservation. Since cancellation wasn't offered in their options when booking, Booking asked the hostel, giving them the choice to accept or not; they refused, saying it's Booking's fault (even though Booking lets them decide). In short, what matters is their money, not customer satisfaction. On arrival day I couldn't eat dinner because I hadn't booked for the meal, knowing that the reservation must be made before 16:00, which you discover only after check-in, so for those checking in after 16:00 don't count on a meal the first night. Breakfasts are basic: white bread, peanut butter, jam and instant coffee. Public spaces aren’t very pleasant and not conducive to meeting people. The terrace which looked lovely in photos is sloped and looks onto a wooden fence (so forget the nice view). And you will encounter many cockroaches. The beds are fine but there is no way to open the windows and it is very hot in the rooms. The air conditioning is very noisy. By the way, the female 6-bed dorm I stayed in is in the basement with a large window facing the street, no curtain, so anyone can see us.

Le disposizioni delle camere sono labirintiche, ma soprattutto non ho trovato alcun personaggio dello staff materialmente presente per darmi spiegazioni o aiutarmi sul posto.

Sicuramente l'esperienza è stata inficiata da tre coinquilini oggettivamente sporchi (mai più nella camera 302/A), ma basterebbe un minimo di controllo delle camere per richiamare all'ordine chi ci dorme.

analysis.title_en: The worst choice for experiencing Sydney as a tourist
analysis.positive_en: The only positive note: the proximity to the centre and affordable prices. Nothing more.
analysis.negative_en: The property appears seemingly valid from the photos only to surprise you, negatively, with cramped spaces, sanitary facilities not exactly clean and rooms kept in pitiable condition. Additionally, the air conditioning service did not work, and on a sunny day at 36°C it should be the first thing to function properly. The room layouts are labyrinthine, but above all I could not find any staff member physically present to give explanations or help on site. Surely the experience was spoiled by three roommates who were objectively dirty (never again in room 302/A), but at least a minimum check of the rooms would be enough to call those staying there to order. Surely the worst experience in terms of hostel, nothing to do with the Brisbane Quarters colleagues.

Crowded, weird vibe
reviews.positive: Only positives were that the bed had blackout curtains, and there were lockers. The company was pretty responsive on the chat function.
reviews.negative:
I’m not really sure how this place gets an It was crowded, not nearly enough social areas or showers/toilets for the amount of people staying there. There were clearly quite a few people staying in the hostel longer term and there were peoples personal belongings all over the room, so it felt messy. There were extension cables daisy chained across the room to provide power to the beds which is a massive fire hazard. I counted 6 extensions connected to one wall outlet (it’s an old building so there is clearly a shortage of sockets)
The beds were really creaky so you couldn’t move without disturbing others. Pillows need replacing as well as they were very lumpy. 
Breakfast was ok, basic (toast and cereal, instant coffee/tea) also finishes at 9 which is quite early. The free dinner was again basic but tasted pretty good (chicken and rice). The table area is so small though that people were sat in the corridor to eat because there was no space. 
Views of the bridge are good from the female bathroom and maybe one or two of the rooms, the fences are too high in the outdoor area to actually see it though. 
Biggest annoyance was that there were no staff at the hostel itself, so when you checked in you had to download an app just to be able to get into your room. The doors seem to just be always open and people wander in and out. I had to help a group of older folks check in because they couldn’t work the passcode for the door and there was nobody else to help them. 
There are cleaners around sometimes but I don’t think they are directly employed by the property. They also start hoovering at 8am which can be heard all over the building so good luck if you want a lie in. 
As I’m backpacking I was looking for a budget option as the options are limited and everywhere is so expensive, but it’s worth paying just a little bit more for much better hostels in Sydney.

reviews.positive:
Ik snap niet hoe dit hostel zo'n hoge gemiddelde beoordeling kan hebben. Daar heb ik van geleerd dat ik in het vervolg naar het aantal onvoldoendes moet kijken, niet naar het gemiddelde cijfer. Tijdens mijn 2 maanden reizen, was dit namelijk veruit het slechtste hostel. Ik wilde er eigenlijk snel weg, maar zat vast aan de reservering. De lijst aan teleurstellingen is lang, maar als ik iets positiefs moet noemen:
De locatie is top. Leuke omgeving en goed bereikbaar. Het personeel was ook behulpzaam en via whatsapp te bereiken.
reviews.negative:
De foto's op booking.com zijn misleidend. De foto's zijn van een klein deel van het hostel dat blijkbaar destijds gerenoveerd is. In werkelijkheid   is het een vervallen en slecht onderhouden pand. Zie bijvoorbeeld mijn foto's van de badkamer op mijn verdieping, dat zegt genoeg.
Verder:
- Het matras was zeer slecht. Harde veringen die uitstaken.
- Het kussen was zeer slecht. Zelfs dubbelgevouwen gaf het geen ondersteuning.
- De kamer was niet schoon toen ik erin kwam. Er lag nog afval van de vorige gast. Dit is wel opgelost nadat ik het heb gemeld.
- Door de mobiele airco sloot het raam niet af. Ze hebben het met ducktape afgeplakt maar er zaten grote kieren in.
- Zeer veel herrie en geluidsoverlast hierdoor. Zelfs met oordoppen in kon ik niet slapen.
- Als je vegetarier bent kun je er beter niet eten. Ze laten dan het vlees gewoon weg. Wat bleef er over: rijst met aardappelpuree. Daarna maar ergens anders gaan eten.
- Ontbijten kun je beter aan de overkant doen.
- Geen handdoeken bij de wc was ook best onhandig.
- Je moet online inchecken. Op zich geen probleem, als het werkt. Ik kreeg steeds foutmeldingen, erg frustrerend. Na hulp van het personeel via whatsapp is het uiteindelijk gelukt.
- De deurcodes werkten niet altijd, ook dat moest via whatsapp opgelost worden.
- De prijs is belachelijk hoog voor wat je ervoor terugkrijgt.
Kortom, maak niet de fout die ik heb gemaakt en kies een ander hostel.
reviews.partner_reply:
Hi Sven,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your stay didn’t meet your expectations, but we truly appreciate the opportunity to improve.

Our hostel is continuously evolving, and while some areas have been recently renovated, we are actively working on further upgrades to enhance guest comfort. Cleanliness is a top priority for us, and we will ensure our housekeeping team remains diligent in preparing rooms to the highest standard.

Our staff is always available to assist, and we’re glad they could help you with check-in and key access. We appreciate your comments on the meals and will review how we can improve vegetarian options. As for pricing, we aim to offer a great stay in a central location, and we’re always looking for ways to enhance the overall guest experience.

We regret that your stay wasn’t what you had hoped for, but we truly value your input. We hope you’ll see the improvements we’re making should you choose to visit us again in the future. Safe travels!

analysis.positive_en: I don’t understand how this hostel can have such a high average rating. During my 2 months of travel, this was by far the worst hostel. I wanted to leave quickly, but I was stuck with the reservation. The list of disappointments is long, but if I must mention something positive: The location is great. Nice area and well accessible. The staff were also helpful and reachable via WhatsApp.
analysis.negative_en:
The photos on Booking.com are misleading. The photos are of a small part of the hostel that apparently was renovated at the time. In reality it is a dilapidated and poorly maintained building. See my bathroom photos on my floor, that says enough. Furthermore:
- The mattress was very bad. Springs sticking out.
- The pillow was very bad. Even folded in half it offered no support.
- The room was not clean when I entered. There was trash from the previous guest. This was resolved after I reported it.
- Because of the mobile air conditioner the window did not close. They taped it with duct tape but there were large gaps.
- A lot of noise and disturbance, even with earplugs I couldn’t sleep.
- If you are vegetarian you’d better not eat there. They simply omit the meat. What remained: rice with mashed potatoes. Then went somewhere else to eat.
- Breakfast you’d better have across the street.
- No towels at the toilet was also quite inconvenient.
- You must check in online. Not a problem, if it works. I kept getting error messages, very frustrating. After help from staff via WhatsApp it eventually worked.
- The door codes did not always work, also that had to be solved via WhatsApp.
- The price is ridiculously high for what you get.
In short, don’t make the mistake I did and choose another hostel.

issues.issue: staff were helpful and reachable via WhatsApp
building is dilapidated and poorly maintained
door codes did not always work
price is ridiculously high for what you get

The twin dorm room had a lot of space, lockers and a sink.
You can pay with your card for the washer and dryer and also dry your clothes outside.
The free breakfast is ok (toast, coffee, cereal).
reviews.negative:
General: There is no permanent staff working there just backpackers that are being severly micro managed and cannot make any decisions without checking in with management. This slows communication down. Reception is also not available for long stretches of time.
There were lots of useful rules posted everywhere but nobody was there to enforce them (e.g. no talking in the halls/outside people's rooms, no drinking, no smoking)

Room: The room was hot, the window could not be opened and we had to run the little mobile aircon all the time which created a lot of noise. The bunk bed was an old metal bed that made noise ever time you moved.

Kitchen/Food: We were assured that there would be a vegetarian option for the free dinner but in reality that usually ment you got rice and salad and no meat. That is not a balanced meal.

Facilities: Not enough bathrooms! Most bathrooms are also toilets, so if someone is showering nobody can use the toilet. The bathrooms were never properly cleaned, there was dirt and hair in the corners. The outside areas were also rarely or never taken care of. The dryer had a big layer of lint and dust behind the back filter which looked like a huge fire hazard.
No (inside) common area apart from the table in the kitchen and a bunch of chairs in the hallway.

Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia.

I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code.

I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm.

When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed.

I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm.

I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told.

I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor.

By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service.

My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address.

This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.

While we appreciate that you contacted us earlier in the day regarding dinner, our complimentary dinner is served only during the designated dinner service period. As we do not reserve or hold individual portions, we’re unable to guarantee a meal for guests who arrive after the dinner service has ended. This is in place to help us manage food safely and fairly for all guests.

That said, we acknowledge that this should have been communicated clearly to you in advance, particularly after you had contacted us about dinner. We apologise for any misunderstanding or inconvenience this caused.

Regarding the check-in and door-code issues, we understand how frustrating it must have been to wait with your luggage and receive an incorrect code. We are reviewing the circumstances and communication with the team involved to ensure that guests receive clear and accurate information and prompt assistance when issues arise.

We appreciate your feedback and are sorry that your arrival did not reflect the level of service we aim to provide.

analysis.negative_en:
The system said check-in information would be sent before 3 PM, but for two days none of it arrived (different room types require re-check-in); had to go on-site and communicate with a video desk, and on the second day waited for a password to complete the check-in, which was very inefficient.

1) Compared to other hostels, you must provide all amenities yourself (towels, shower gel, shampoo) despite paying for the stay.
2) The room only has a central light; if you return late, there is no proper lighting and you can only use your phone to illuminate the room.
3) The sink in the bathroom has no counter space to place bottles, making usage very inconvenient—items can only be placed on the toilet.
These aren’t unreasonable requests, yet none of these are provided here.
Overall, I regret choosing this place; it is far worse than any hostel I’ve stayed in before and I do not recommend it.

reviews.title: Muy buena ubicación y relación calidad-precio, con algunos detalles operativos
reviews.positive: La ubicación es excelente: está muy bien conectado y se puede llegar fácilmente desde el aeropuerto en metro, prácticamente sales de la estación y estás ahí. Las habitaciones son cómodas para ser un hostel, con buen ambiente y huéspedes respetuosos. Tiene buen WiFi, cocina equipada para guardar comida, varias duchas y baños disponibles, y servicios como lavandería que hacen la estancia práctica. En general, ofrece una muy buena relación calidad-precio considerando lo céntrico que es.
reviews.negative: El acceso con equipaje puede ser incómodo, ya que hay escaleras y las habitaciones están en el segundo o tercer piso, y esto podría comunicarse mejor en el anuncio para que los huéspedes estén más preparados. Tampoco es muy práctico el servicio de storage gratuito que ofrecen: tuve que caminar hasta otra propiedad de la misma cadena, lo que implicó una subir la cuestas de Surry Hills y es una caminata de unos 30 minutos, pero es más rápido si se hace en Uber. El sistema de recepción es remoto (pantallas con atención desde fuera del país), lo que puede hacer el check-in más lento o confuso. Además, las puertas con código a veces fallan, lo cual puede ser incómodo. Finalmente, al estar en una zona con vida nocturna, puede haber algo de ruido los fines de semana, y la limpieza es correcta pero no impecable.
reviews.room_type: Mixed Pod 6 Beds Room with Shared Bathroom
reviews.partner_reply: Thanks for your detailed feedback! 😊 We’re glad you enjoyed the location, atmosphere, and overall value. We appreciate your comments about access, luggage handling, and check-in—we’ll work on improving communication and convenience. Your notes on noise and cleanliness are also noted. Hope to welcome you again!

analysis.title_en: Great location and good value for money, with some operational details
analysis.positive_en: The location is excellent: very well connected and easily reachable from the airport by metro; you basically step out of the station and you’re there. The rooms are comfortable for a hostel, with a good vibe and respectful guests. Good WiFi, kitchen equipped to store food, several showers and bathrooms available, and services like laundry that make the stay practical. Overall, it offers very good value for money given how central it is.
analysis.negative_en: Access with luggage can be awkward, as there are stairs and the rooms are on the second or third floor, and this could be better communicated in the listing so guests are more prepared. Also, the free storage service they offer isn’t very practical: I had to walk to another property of the same chain, which involved climbing hills in Surry Hills and is about a 30-minute walk, though it’s faster by Uber. The reception system is remote (screens with service from outside the country), which can make check-in slower or confusing. Additionally, the doors with codes sometimes fail, which can be inconvenient. Finally, being in an area with nightlife, there can be some noise on weekends, and the cleaning is fine but not immaculate.

reviews.title: Wet carpet, stinky room, unhelpful staff - wouldn't recommend at all
reviews.negative: I arrived to my room and found that the carpet was very wet and as a result the room smelled extremely musty and mouldy. I couldn't take my shoes off in the room or I would soak my feet and socks. When I raised the issue with the accommodation, they did the bare minimum by putting a towel on the floor (half the room's carpet was wet) and leaving a bottle of disinfectant spray. No alternative room was arranged, and there was no initiative to offer compensation in any way. When I asked the issue to be escalated to management, they said it'd take 7-10 business days and when I waited 10 business days I had to follow up again because I hadn't heard anything. This place clearly thinks they can offer poor services and get away with it. I know they offer cheap rooms, so I was expecting something quite modest and minimal, but a room with a soaking wet floor is a whole new level of poor quality. Do NOT recommend.

The reception is a screen with someone you talk to; when we reported problems with the food they told me it wasn’t a service you were paying for, that it was something offered by the accommodation as an extra, when it says it’s included in the price.

analysis.title_en: Few toilets, no staff in the hotel, luggage storage also requires going elsewhere.
analysis.positive_en: The location is convenient, with breakfast and dinner; I can't think of any other advantages; if it weren't for not finding a room during the New Year, I wouldn't choose this place; really one stay is enough.
analysis.negative_en: There are very few toilets, only one toilet on each floor; the floor I stayed on could accommodate up to 30 people, so if every floor has someone using the toilet at the same time, you have to go to a nearby station to use the facilities. This is not suitable for people with stomach issues. There are no staff on site, only a screen you can video with to handle check-in and check-out; no staff in the hotel means there is no one who can resolve issues immediately. Luggage storage requires going elsewhere; when you ask customer service, they give an address and you have to take your luggage somewhere else. It’s troublesome, so there is effectively no luggage storage. If not for the New Year when I couldn’t find a room, I wouldn’t choose this place; really, one stay is enough.

reviews.title: Disgusting place
reviews.positive: The name. Azzurro
reviews.negative:
1. Staff non-existent. I arrived around 11:30 pm, no reception just a tablet at the entrance to get in touch with some mysterious person, but it wasn't working properly. 
2. They send you a "key" through Goki, supposedly to use your phone. This key wasn't working. No staff to turn to.
3. No towel. Somehow, after 1 hour of trying, I managed to get in touch with somebody through whatsapp?, and they gave me indications how to open a locker and get a towel.
4. The bathrooms were disgusting, gross, filthy and completely inadequate to use. Nowhere to place my stuff (shampoo, toothbrush and so on), nowhere to hang my towel or clothes. Hot water only came after a while. No shower curtain, meaning that the water went onto the nearby toilet, wetting everything, including the toilet paper, which miraculously, was there.
5. 60 dollars for this is far too expensive. No breakfast included and frankly, a fastfood toilet looks better, than this place. These things are not so expensive, a shelf, a hook, a shower curtain. I've been to far better places for half of the price.
6. A lady was constantly coughing and sneezing in a bed next to mine, spreading viruses everywhere. Why do they accept ill people among other 5? 

Basic standards of hygiene, health and safety are not respected.
Not recommend.

reviews.title: I went to the room and left
reviews.positive: I don't have any positive feedback. I found the info on the page confusing and the experience frustrating
reviews.negative: I turned up to the room and I thought I had booked a room with 2 bunk beds and a private bathroom. It said twin so I thought I had booked for the 2 people even though I was traveling on my own. I wanted to book the room for myself and was happy to pay for both. The price looked to be double the single person rate. But someone else, a stranger, was already sleeping in the bottom bunk when I arrived. I have back issues so the top bunk was not very easy for me and I had thought I would be able to use the bottom bunk when I made the booking. I recently did a similar thing at another place in Bondi. It was only 9pm and the other person already had their stuff literally all over the place, in the room, the kitchenette and the bathroom, and they were already asleep in the bottom bunk. They also had the aircon blaring on some hot setting so the room was like an oven. I tried to message the chat as there was no staff there that I could find and they took ages to reply. I asked if there was another room I could change to and they said no they were already booked. I asked for a locker I could use to put my personal things in with a lock. They finally replied and said there was a locker but you have to bring your own lock. Which I didn't have with me... and I did not see info about this on the pages or messages/emails. It was very heavy rain outside so I sat in the kitchen for a bit to try and figure out what to do.. I decided to book a room at another hotel near by which was expensive but I needed to be able to sleep for the next day of work and not have to sleep in some kind of sauna with a stranger and no security for my belongings. I don't usually leave negative reviews but I was really put out with this experience. They did try to apologise on the chat and offer me a different private room for another night with a small discount but I was only staying one night in Sydney for work. Much clearer info on the page would have helped.

reviews.title: Smelly, dirty, tiny, not like photos. Potential bed bugs. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.positive: Worst place I’ve stayed in Oz by far. Ratings must be from bots, check Google reviews and they’re really low. Photos misleading. After traveling for 3 days I arrive to a room that was really smelly, that deep feet and smelly socks smell, looks like it hasn’t been cleaned or freshened up for days, there’s peoples belongings literally all over the place and I don’t even have enough space to open my luggage, a small surf bag, the place is so tiny, literally so small. The aircon was right beside my bed by my head and it was full of dust and dirt, pumping air right into my nostrils. Disgusting. Furniture old and worn out.
reviews.negative: People living there treating it like their own bedroom and the staff (staff, what staff!?) do nothing about it. “Thanks for your patience” is all they had to say to me via text. Woke up to a guest asking for his mattress to be changed because he had been itchy for a few days and full of bites, potentially bed bugs. 24h later and the management was still unaware as I had contacted them again to express my discontent. Had to deep clean all my clothes and belongings upon departure. Also, there’s signs everywhere saying you’ll get a fine of you break any rules. Everywhere, it’s so unwelcoming. $100 dollar fine for not doing the dishes? My god is that ridiculous. No alcohol allowed on premises so no glass of wine over dinner, bizarre. Breakfast is peanut butter and jam and they ran out of jam. Usually not a big deal but c’mon. No plant based milk alternative. No staff to be seen in sight, the breakfast person/morning cleaner young kid, really kind but shy and avoids eye contact. Who is responsible for this place?? Any enquiry via text is answering by AI. Absolutely terrible experience. Avoid at all costs.

We also apologize that our complimentary breakfast and check-in process didn’t meet your expectations. We strive for a smooth and efficient check-in experience and will take your feedback into account as we work to enhance this.

We regret the inconvenience caused by having to take a taxi to store your luggage elsewhere. We’ll take note of this to improve the guest experience.

Your feedback is truly valuable, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a better experience in the future.


Best regards,
Customer Service
Azzurro Pod Hotel

reviews.negative:
Vorsicht vor diesem Hostel – entspricht in keiner Weise den Standards von Booking.com

Ich bin wirklich enttäuscht von meinem Aufenthalt in diesem Hostel und kann es niemandem empfehlen. Bereits bei der Ankunft war der Eindruck negativ – auf dem Boden liefen Kakerlaken, was auf mangelnde Hygiene und unzureichende Reinigung hinweist.

Es gibt kein „Aufbewahrungsraum“ für Gepäck

Das Essen ist nicht genießbar: jeden Tag dasselbe, und zu allem Überfluss war das servierte Hühnchen teilweise roh. Das ist nicht nur unappetitlich, sondern auch gesundheitsschädlich.

Die Online-Bewertungen, die ich vor der Buchung gelesen habe, scheinen offensichtlich manipuliert oder gekauft zu sein – sie spiegeln in keiner Weise die Realität wider.

Die Gemeinschaftsbereiche sind unzureichend: Es gibt nur einen einzigen überfüllten „Community Room“, der für die Anzahl der Gäste viel zu klein ist. Auch die Sanitäranlagen sind ein Problem – es gibt viel zu wenige Badezimmer, und man steht morgens ewig in der Schlange.

Ich fordere Booking.com dringend auf, dieses Hostel zu überprüfen. Es entspricht in keiner Weise den auf der Plattform versprochenen Standards. Am besten wäre es, dieses Objekt aus dem Angebot zu entfernen. Es geht hier nicht nur um Komfort, sondern auch um Sicherheit und Gesundheit der Gäste
reviews.room_type: Mixed Pod 8 Beds Room with Shared Bathroom - Large Room

analysis.negative_en: Beware of this hostel – it in no way meets Booking.com standards. I am really disappointed with my stay and would not recommend it to anyone. Upon arrival, cockroaches were on the floor, indicating poor hygiene and insufficient cleaning. There is no luggage storage. The food is inedible: every day the same, and the served chicken was sometimes raw. This is not only unappetizing but also potentially harmful to health. The online reviews I read before booking seem obviously manipulated or bought – they do not reflect reality. The communal areas are inadequate: there is only one overcrowded “Community Room” that is far too small for the number of guests. The facilities are also a problem – there are far too few bathrooms, and you have to queue for ages in the morning. I strongly urge Booking.com to investigate this hostel. It does not meet the standards promised on the platform. Ideally, this property should be removed from the listings. This is about not only comfort but also safety and guests’ health.

reviews.title: If you're looking for a reliable, clean, and convenient place to stay, this is a fantastic choice.
reviews.positive:
In January I spent a night at this hostel, and I can confidently say it exceeded my expectations in every way. As someone traveling through the city on a tight schedule, I couldn’t have asked for a better base. This hostel truly lives up to its name—everything is central and within easy reach. Whether you're heading out to explore the city, catch a train, or find a quick bite, the location makes everything simple and stress-free.

From the moment I arrived, the check-in process was smooth and efficient. I was especially impressed by the remote reception system, which is available 24/7. It made late arrival and general communication a breeze—no waiting around or confusion. It’s clear that the staff here are not only organized, but also genuinely care about the guests. 

My room was clean and well-kept, with fresh sheets and a bed that was surprisingly comfortable—just the right firmness for a great night’s sleep. I appreciated the quiet atmosphere at night, which is especially important when you're trying to recharge.

One small detail that really stood out was how accurate the online photos were. It's always a gamble booking places based on pictures, but in this case, what I saw online was exactly what I got. That level of transparency built even more trust and added to my overall satisfaction.

Stairwells are old, beds are cranky (made of steel), no shampoos, body wash, hair dryer, towels or soap provided. Amenities are occupied for most of the time, with around ten seats are provided in public spaces, with fancy kitchen, that is basically all for public space.
Moreover, I waited for 1.5 hour for air conditioner to be opened, it was 11:30pm when it started working. No talking allowed in the room. And the hot water is not stable.
If you are fine living in an old building with only bed, limited shower rooms and two meals provided, it might be fine for you, otherwise, please think twice.

reviews.title: I do not recommend
reviews.positive:
I wouldn’t recommend this hostel. Unfortunately, my stay was quite disappointing.

From the start, it was inconvenient—I had to carry my suitcase up two flights of stairs. The rooms were very warm at night, and cleanliness was lacking. I stayed in a room with a shared bathroom for nearly a week, and it didn’t seem to be cleaned at all during that time. Basic amenities like body soap and shampoo weren’t provided, so after a long flight, I had to use hand soap to shower. There were also no hair dryers available.

There’s no staff on-site, so if you have any issues, you need to message them and wait for a response. The walls are quite thin, so noise carries easily. If guests are talking late at night or moving luggage around—which happened often—you’ll hear it, even with earplugs.

Unlike many hostels that offer USB ports at each bunk for convenience, this one doesn’t, so be sure to bring a converter.

I originally booked this place to save a little money because the photos looked promising, but unfortunately, it didn’t live up to expectations. The one positive is its location—it’s close to Central Station, making it easy to get around. However, for a more comfortable stay, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.

I dont really write negative reviews but we didn’t have a good experience here at all and wouldn’t stay again. reviews.positive: La ubicación.
reviews.negative:
A pesar de haber vivido una experiencia muy negativa con una de las huéspedes, el problema lo tenía ella y creo que cuando alguien contrata un hostel debería ser consciente de que es un alojamiento compartido y que no es su habitación privada y por lo tanto generar una sensación de desprecio y mala educación por ser suave no es compatible con un hostel y su multiculturalidad y eso debería ser un mandatory step cuando uno reserva/ hace checkin. Esta chica no lo tenia claro. 
El hotel NO TIENE RECEPCIONISTA, cosa que en mi opinión fomenta este tipo de situaciones dado que se ven si la figura de un staff en el hotel y la consecuente autoridad. Cuando llegas tienes que escanear un QR para hacerte el auto checkin y sin internet es imposible hacerlo. Asegúrate si escoges este hotel de contrar un plan de datos en el aeropuerto. Nadie te va a atender en persona a tu llegada. 

He de decir que el alojamiento a pesar de que no  tiene un recepción. Tiene una App que hace de recepcionista y mostró bastante interés y a pesar de que el problema no era yo, me cambiaron de habitación por mi comodidad. 

Sin embargo a pesar de ser atentos a mi experiencia es importante recalcar que las instalaciones dejan bastante que desear. Literas ruidosas, casilleros ruidosos hasta para cuando uno intenta no hacer ruido. Limpieza muy mejorable. El punto positivo es la cocina y el laundry secadora y lavadora de las  que puedes disponer por unos 2,5€ el programa. 

Sinceramente la puntuación de Booking.com no la veo acorde con la realidad, dejando aparte el problema de encontrarte con algún huésped intolerante y con poca educación.
reviews.room_type: Mixed Pod 6 Beds Room with Shared Bathroom

analysis.title_en: Hostel for one night and run away.
analysis.positive_en: The location.
analysis.negative_en: Despite having a very negative experience with one of the guests, the problem was with her and I think when someone books a hostel they should be aware that it is shared accommodation and not their private room, and therefore generating a sense of contempt and bad manners is not compatible with a hostel and its multiculturalism and that should be a mandatory step when you reserve/check in. This girl didn't have it clear. The hotel DOES NOT HAVE A RECEPTIONIST, which in my opinion encourages this kind of situations since you can see no staff figure and the consequent lack of authority. When you arrive you have to scan a QR to do self check-in and without internet it's impossible to do. Make sure if you choose this hotel to have a data plan at the airport. No one will attend you in person on arrival. I must say that although it doesn't have a reception, they have an App that acts as receptionist and showed interest and although the problem wasn't me, they moved me to another room for my comfort. However, despite them being attentive to my experience it is important to note that the facilities leave much to be desired. Noisy bunk beds, noisy lockers even when you try not to make noise. Cleaning very improvable. The positive point is the kitchen and the laundry dryer and washing machine that you can use for about €2.5 per program. Honestly I don't see Booking.com rating matching reality, apart from the issue of running into an intolerant and poorly educated guest.

reviews.positive: The dinner is good, but the fired chicken is terrible. Also, it seems only two or three kinds that are not good for staying longer than one week.
reviews.negative:
Maybe not everyone met this situation but I felt it is so terrible place. No reception and only online service. Communication was so bed. 我們要求下舖，對方回覆已經紀錄。結果完全沒有安排。電腦後面的人總是有不一樣的藉口。說是系統自動回覆。無法控制。剛到冷氣就壞了。然後遙控器無法操控，晚上遙控器被拿走，說是系統自動控制。結果晚上fucking cold，一直被冷醒，完全無法睡覺。連續三天。半夜三點冷醒，要求客服處理，回覆說早上七點才有人上班，一個小時後來了一個員工，但相當不專業。一進來就打開燈，大聲講電話。幾乎所有員工都是印度人，這無妨，但他們對於房間相當不熟悉，幾乎完全無法處理。客服躲在背後遙控，但完全沒有人可以立即解決問題。只會說抱歉，卻沒有任何實質作為。這是我二十年來待過服務最差的青旅。Booking 應該慎選合作對象，或者排除這樣的青旅。
網路差，短片常延遲。浴室差，只有三間，洗澡要等很久。廚房及公共空間小，插座少，完全不像經營青旅。
reviews.room_type: Mixed Pod 8 Beds Room with Shared Bathroom - Large Room
reviews.partner_reply:
Hi Hsuanching, we're sorry to hear that your stay did not meet your expectations. We appreciate your honest feedback and take your concerns seriously. While we’re glad you enjoyed the dinner, we understand that food variety is important, and we will consider this for future improvements. Regarding communication and service, we apologize for any miscommunication or inconvenience you experienced. We strive to provide responsive and efficient assistance, and your feedback will help us refine our processes.

We regret any discomfort caused by the air conditioning, room arrangements, and facility limitations. Our team is continuously working on enhancing the guest experience, including better coordination in managing room requests and maintenance issues. We value your input and will use it to make meaningful improvements. Thank you for sharing your thoughts.

analysis.negative_en: Maybe not everyone faced this, but I found it a terrible place. No reception and only online service. Communication was very poor. We requested something, was told it was recorded, but nothing was arranged. The staff behind the computer kept making excuses, saying it was an automatic system reply and that nothing could be controlled. On arrival the air conditioning was already broken. Then the remote control could not be operated; at night the remote was taken away, again claimed to be system-controlled. It became freezing cold at night, waking me up, and I could not sleep for three consecutive nights. At 3am I woke in the cold and asked for help; they said someone would be on duty at 7am, and after an hour a staff member came, but was very unprofessional. He walked in with the lights on, talking loudly on the phone. Almost all staff were Indian, which is not a problem, but they were unfamiliar with the rooms and could not handle issues. Customer service hid behind the control and could not resolve problems immediately. They only apologized and did nothing substantive. This is the worst hostel I’ve stayed in in twenty years. Booking should be selective about partners or exclude this hostel. Internet is poor, videos lag. The bathrooms are poor; only three, so long waits to shower. Kitchen and public spaces are small, outlets few, not at all like a youth hostel.

issues.issue: unprofessional staff and poor handling of issues
air conditioning not working / cold nights
remote control / AC system not functioning properly
kitchen and common spaces small with few outlets
staff unfamiliar with rooms and slow to resolve issues
